reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is for **185 seats**.

That number comes from Dana's own post in #north-team (she's a member) on 2025-08-20. She first wrote 180, then corrected it a few minutes later: "It's 185, not 180." I couldn't find the amendment file itself in the shared files, so I told her the best check before the deck goes out is the signed copy she sent to June Osei-Lark.

A seat count isn't a money figure, so I didn't need anyone's approval to share it. I didn't send any prices or contract terms.
